user.title: Resource Queue Manager (FIFO)
user.description: Configure the maximum number of simultaneous resource reservations.

request.name: Request slot
request.description: Request a FIFO slot without actuating an entity.

resource_id.name: Resource ID
resource_id.description: Stable resource identifier, for example zone_1.

entity_id.name: Supervised entity
entity_id.description: Supervised light or switch entity that must be OFF before release.

release.name: Release slot
release.description: Release a reservation only if Home Assistant reports its entity OFF.

cancel.name: Cancel request
cancel.description: Remove a waiting request or release an OFF reservation.

resume.name: Resume queue after restart
resume.description: Verify supervised entities and resume FIFO grants. Inspect equipment before recovery.

init.title: Supervised resources and FIFO capacity
init.description: Select supervised light or switch entities and the maximum concurrent reservations. Existing bookings remain protected.

error.storage_unavailable: Cannot read saved bookings. Configuration unchanged.
error.max_active_below_reserved: Cannot reduce the limit below the number of currently active reservations.
error.entities_in_use: Cannot deselect an entity with an active or waiting reservation.
